data.Akshan W: * {{sbc|New Effect:}} During the events of ''Bardle Royale'', ''URF Deathmatch'', and ''Prize Fight'', allied champions that are revived will respawn at the location of their death and with {{as|30% '''maximum''' health}}.
data.Bard I: * Increased chime spawn rate. First chime spawns at 30 seconds, and spawns 2 new ones every 20 seconds.
data.Bel'Veth R: * {{sbc|New Effect:}} Enemy ''Jungle Guardians'' now drop an ''Enhanced Void Coral'' upon death.
data.Ivern I: * {{sbc|Alternative Innate - [[File:Ivern Enemy of the Forest.png|20px]] Enemy of the Forest:}} It's time for '''Ivern's''' revenge.  '''Ivern''' can damage monsters, and they can damage him. Source: Ivern the Cruel.
data.Ivern E: * Detonation damages jungle monsters when cast on himself or {{ai|Daisy!|Ivern|Daisy}}.
data.Kindred I:
* {{sbc|Removed:}} Jungle camps are no longer marked.
    * On-champion-kill stacks changed to 2.
    * {{sbc|New Effect:}} Now always grant a stack when killing the {{ui|Blue Sentinel}}, {{ui|Red Brambleback}} or {{ui|Rift Herald}}.
data.Nasus Q:
* On-kill stacks changed to 6.
    * On-large-kill stacks changed to 24.
data.Mordekaiser R: * When certain Events begin, both '''Mordekaiser''' and his target are immediately forced out of the ''Death Realm'', ending the ability prematurely.
data.Sett R: * Damage against {{ui|Rift Scuttler|Scuttle Racer}}, loot {{ci|Teemo}}, loot {{ci|Veigar}}, and practice dummy is now based off the champion with the most {{as|'''bonus''' health}} on the enemy team.
data.Shyvana I: * {{sbc|Alternative Innate:}} '''Shyvana''' gains {{as|2 '''bonus''' armor}}, {{as|2 '''bonus''' magic resistance}} and {{as|{{fd|0.05}} '''bonus''' Fury regeneration}} whenever she or her allies kill nearby epic monsters, jungle monsters, and {{ui|Rift Scuttler}}.
data.Sion W:
* On-unit-kill bonus health doubled.
    ** (On-{{tip|takedown}} bonus health unchanged).
data.Archangel's Staff: * Each charge consumed generates 50% more mana.
